purpose: M0a corrected selected-extension 4096-unit native inference and modules-only backward workload. Measure the current no-grad inference path separately from backward; no optimizer update and no quality claim.

scope.training: modules_only backward; no optimizer step; base frozen

measurements: writer_requires_grad and sense_requires_grad are false at every inference point
source encode, writer, sense, forward, generation, prepare and backward seconds
sampled MPS allocated/driver bytes and process RSS
stop_conditions: writer_requires_grad or sense_requires_grad is true in inference
schedule point raises an unexpected error

acceptance.accept_if: all 12 points complete, inference producers detached, finite outputs, 28 gradient tensors per backward point, guard completes; record actual peak and do not infer an 8192 limit
acceptance.reject_or_defer_if: any stop condition fires or the schedule is incomplete; preserve partial points and do not relabel the old boundary

retention: Keep run/failure report, progress, profile and guard traces. No base copy, optimizer checkpoint or download.
claims: Corrected native capacity only; no memory quality, generation-quality, generalization or architecture-benefit claim.
